options.title: How Did a Melted Candy Bar Invent the Microwave?
options.first_line: How did a melted candy bar give us the microwave oven?
options.first_frame: A microwave already humming on a dark kitchen counter, its plate turning and its window glowing, as the camera pushes in on the door.

options.title: Why Did Percy Spencer's Candy Bar Melt?
options.first_line: Percy Spencer's candy bar melted in his pocket, and nothing near him was hot. So what cooked it?
options.first_frame: A chocolate bar sagging and dripping inside a lab-coat pocket, a glowing radar tube humming beside it.

options.title: The Microwave Oven Started With a Radar Tube. How?
options.first_line: The microwave oven in your kitchen started life inside a radar set. How did it get there?
options.first_frame: A radar dish turning against a night sky, then the camera dives into the copper tube at its heart.

why: It is about the microwave in the viewer's own kitchen and asks a strange question (how can a melted candy bar invent it?) whose answer only comes by staying, while B names a stranger and shows the radar tube and C gives away the radar origin.
